verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਿਜਾਤੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ ਮੰਗਨਿ ਕਲਪ ਤਰੋਂ ਫਲ ਕਚੇ।
verses.translit_en: paarijaat gur chhadd kai ma(n)gan kalap taro(n) fal kache|

en.bdb: Leaving the wish-fulfilling tree in the form of Guru, people desire to have the raw fruits of traditional wish-fulfilling tree (kalptaru/parijat).

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਲਖ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਸਣੁ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਣੁ ਭਵਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਚੇ।
verses.translit_en: paarajaat lakh surag san aavaa gavan bhavan vich pache|

en.bdb: Millions of parijat along with heavens are getting perished in the cycle of transmigration.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਰਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਦਿਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਚਿ ਵਿਰਚੇ।
verses.translit_en: maradhe kar kar kaamanaa dhit bhugat vich rach virache|

en.bdb: Controlled by desires people are perishing and are busy in enjoying whatever has been bestowed by the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾਰੇ ਹੋਇ ਅਗਾਸ ਚੜਿ ਓੜਕਿ ਤੁਟਿ ਤੁਟਿ ਥਾਨ ਹਲਚੇ।
verses.translit_en: taare hoi agaas chaR oRak tuT tuT thaan halache|

en.bdb: Man of good actions establish in the sky in the form of stars and after exhausting the results of virtues again become falling stars.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਂ ਪਿਉ ਹੋਏ ਕੇਤੜੇ ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਹੋਏ ਬਚੇ।
verses.translit_en: maa(n) piau hoe ketaRe ketaRiaa(n) dhe hoe bache|

en.bdb: Again through transmigration they become mothers and fathers and many beget children.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਉ ਬੀਜਦੇ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਚਹਮਚੇ।
verses.translit_en: paap pu(n)n beeau beejadhe dhukh sukh fal a(n)dhar chahamache|

en.bdb: Further sowing evils and virtues remain immersed in pleasures and sufferings.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਪਰਚੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit_en: gur poore vin har na parache ||12||

en.bdb: Without the perfect Guru, God cannot be made happy.
